tokens.name: pistachio
tokens.usage: The brand field: sign-in story panel, the unbooked card, onboarding side panel. A warm light green that says done. Text on it: `ink` (12:1); overlines `pistachio-ink`.

tokens.name: pistachio-ink
tokens.usage: Overlines and secondary text on `pistachio` (6:1).

tokens.name: lemon
tokens.usage: The yellow highlight: the BTW card, double rules on `forest`, the seal core, count badges, the current-month bar, the camera shutter. Text on it: `ink` (11.5:1). Never text on light grounds.

tokens.name: lemon-tint
tokens.usage: Needs-review and deadline chips, warning banners. Text on it: `lemon-ink`.

tokens.name: lemon-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `lemon-tint`. 7.6:1+.

tokens.name: leaf
tokens.usage: Mid green for the lower bowl of the B on light grounds, chart accents and progress. Graphic only, 3:1 on `cream`; never body text.

tokens.name: forest
tokens.usage: Deep green feature cards (cash, receipt lightbox, the seal ring, forest journal entry). Text on it: `cream`; figures in `lemon` (7.7:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body and amounts on `cream`, `surface`, `sand`, `pistachio`, `lemon`. 12:1+.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, overlines, column headers on `cream`, `surface`, `sand`. 5.7:1+.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Page background, a faint yellow-green paper. Also text on `forest`.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, tables, sheets.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: neutral chips, segmented track, skeletons, header bands.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Illustration and avatars: last year's bars, empty-state shapes, initials. Text on it: `ink`.

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: Primary button: a forest pill in light, a pistachio pill in dark. One per view. Label: `on-action`.

tokens.name: on-action
tokens.usage: Label on `action` (9.8:1 light, 12:1 dark).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around cards. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders. 3.3:1+ on `cream` and `surface`.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Booked, Balanced, Filed. Always with a word and check, since the brand is green too.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Errors, out of balance, overdue. Always with a word and warning icon.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid ring, 3px offset. On `forest` use `lemon`; on `pistachio` and `lemon` use `ink`.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Sign-in and marketing hero. One per page; the key word in italic with the double rule.
